experiences.description:
Recognized for strong partnerships with clients, delivering effective and innovative recruitment 
strategies; Performance management

Une compagnie en recrutement de cadres/ An executive Recruitment Company

As a results-driven leader with a strong focus on strategic planning, financial management, recruitment, team development, and client consultation, I have consistently demonstrated the ability to drive organizational success.

- Developed financial projections and closely monitored divisional profitability, ensuring strict adherence to budget targets.
- Led the end-to-end recruitment process, from cost-effective marketing strategies for open roles to ensuring compliance with organizational recruitment policies, systems, and procedures.
- Expertly leveraged professional networks and social media platforms for proactive candidate sourcing while providing consultation on emerging recruitment trends, best practices, legal updates, and benchmarking against industry standards.
- Spearheaded the development of sales strategies, marketing techniques, and growth programs, while effectively managing and mentoring a high-performing team of Recruiters, Account Managers, and administrative staff.

Through a combination of strategic oversight and hands-on leadership, I have helped drive both client success and internal growth, ensuring optimal outcomes for all stakeholders.

I played a key role in the successful launch and growth of the Accounting & Finance division at QMS. In this capacity, I was responsible for driving business development and managing the placement of top-tier financial professionals, helping to build a strong, high-performing team and contribute to the division's overall success.

As a leader of a dynamic recruiting team, I played a key role in setting and achieving business and performance goals, while expanding existing client relationships and successfully placing Administrative professionals in contract & contract to hire opportunities.

- Directed the staff and sales activities of the Officeteam division, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
- Managed budgeting and sales forecasting to drive growth and meet targets.
- Cultivated and maintained strong, long-term relationships with both clients and candidates, ensuring a high level of satisfaction and success.
- Led the hiring and training of new staff, fostering a high-performing and collaborative team environment.

As Manager overseeing all three flagship stores during major renovations, I was responsible for driving operations, leading staff, and ensuring business continuity throughout the process.

- Managed store operations during and after renovations, ensuring smooth transitions and continued success.
- Led the recruitment, hiring, training, and coaching of a diverse team (ranging from 10 to 80 employees).
- Oversaw inventory management, sales forecasting, and effective merchandising strategies to maximize profitability.
- Administered financial management, including budget oversight and cost control measures.
- Led team meetings, implemented incentive programs, and set clear goals to drive performance.
- Managed performance, including conducting employee evaluations, providing coaching, and handling dismissals when necessary.
- Consistently ensured that store objectives were exceeded through strong leadership and a focus on team development.
